We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.
During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

This role is 100% commission-based , which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.
Training Period (Weeks 1–4)
We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:
Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).
Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.
Week 0: Unpaid
Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum
Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum
Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum
By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually
Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually
*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.
What will you be doing?
Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an ¿I can do that¿ mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance. FOR POSITIONS AT GAS STATIONS ONLY: May assist with regular fuel lane maintenance including the handling and cleanup of hazardous materials or substances. Must wear appropriate PPE when required.

Must pass and maintain current fuel safety training as required.
At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

Do you want to join a great startup as SALES & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE (S&BDR) You’re interested in sales and marketing ? You love finding creative solutions to complex issues? You want to work with a young and dynamic team of incredibly driven people, to accelerate our growth?

We have ambitious goals for the coming months, and we need ambitious new team mates to reach them. We’d love your help here! You don’t focus on closing business, but connecting with as many leads as possible ( inbound and outbound) and determining if they’re good customer fits. We will need you to help us move these leads through the sales pipeline. You will work hand in hand with the marketing team and you will be a fueling the pipe and the sales team with great leads.

You will be helping for - contact every lead and determine who stays and who goes. - educate, answer questions, and send resources to potential customers. - Qualify leads and move them through the sales process.

REQUIREMENTS Organization and time management Resilience and determination Great at making first contact Conversational skills Proactive and autonomous Excellent interpersonal skills Rigorous and methodical (results-driven & documentation) Be super fluent in English, and native in French and/or Dutch.

WHAT YOU WILL GET Tremendous growth opportunities Be a part of a dynamic team focused on taking Commuty to the next level Cool work environment that is caring, fun, and collaborative Office in Louvain-la-Neuve & Brussels, with a strong culture of remote work A salary package in line with your experience and skills Last but not least, the satisfaction of making a positive impact on society and employee well-being ‍ A WORD ABOUT COMMUTY Commuty is a Belgian startup founded 6 years ago with the powerful will to make a difference and address environmental challenges of our society.

Our 1st focus is the workplace: we develop a software to improve parking & desk management and boost green mobility in companies & office buildings. We make complex workplace issues become super easy to deal with, thanks to digitization and innovation.

At the end of the day, we help employees organize their workday in the most efficient, happy and green way! INTERESTED? Apply ! If your application is selected we will get in touch to organize: Screening call of 30min Case In-person/videocall Case review interview of 1hr Fit interview with our co-founders of 1 hour‍ Talk soon!

Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of Crossplane , and we’re building the Intelligent Control Plane —a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable .
Our mission is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents . We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence.
Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across 100+ countries . Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide . We’re a Series B company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital , and we’ve raised $69M to date. Learn more at upbound.io
As a Business Development Representative at Upbound , you will own early-stage pipeline generation and serve as the first touchpoint in the sales cycle. You’ll play a critical role in growing our pipeline by engaging high-intent prospects who have shown interest in Crossplane , while also sourcing and developing new opportunities through targeted outbound efforts.
In this role, you will qualify inbound leads, execute focused outbound outreach, and set up high-quality discovery conversations for the sales team. You’ll build meaningful relationships within the community, research and engage target accounts, and support events, sales operations, and special projects.

Serving as a key bridge between Marketing and Sales , your primary mission is to generate qualified pipeline and help fuel Upbound’s growth. You will report directly to the Head of BDR and work closely with both the Sales and Marketing teams.

Establish and maintain a collaborative, strategic partnership with the assigned AE’s.
Engage marketing-qualified leads, event attendees, and high-intent prospects through thoughtful, multi-channel outreach.
Target prospects through research and personalization using email, phone, LinkedIn, Slack communities, and other channels.
Research accounts within defined segments and verticals to identify target personas and generate sales-qualified leads.
Book qualified meetings with IT, engineering, and executive stakeholders for the Account Executives you support.
Have meaningful discovery conversations to understand prospect challenges and articulate the value of Crossplane and Upbound.
Outbound and source your own leads through various channels using research and creatively to book meetings.

A Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
1–2 years of experience in sales, marketing, or a related role.
Comfort operating in a technical environment; open source and/or infrastructure exposure is strongly preferred.
Hunter mentality, resourcefulness, and self-starter.
A genuine interest in building relationships, networking, and starting conversations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience using sales and marketing tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Marketo, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

You’re familiar with Crossplane and/or Upbound
Familiarity with CNCF or other open source cloud-native projects.
You’ve worked at a Series A, B or C startup

Why Upbound?
At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.
About Upbound
Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries.

The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents.

Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date.

For more information, visit www.upbound.io .

Who We Are BioMarin is a global biotechnology company that relentlessly pursues bold science to translate genetic discoveries into new medicines that advance the future of human health.

Since our founding in 1997, we have applied our scientific expertise in understanding the underlying causes of genetic conditions to create transformative medicines, using a number of treatment modalities. Using our unparalleled expertise in genetics and molecular biology, we develop medicines for patients with significant unmet medical need.

We enlist the best of the best – people with the right technical expertise and a relentless drive to solve real problems – and create an environment that empowers our teams to pursue bold, innovative science.

With this distinctive approach to drug discovery, we’ve produced a diverse pipeline of commercial, clinical and preclinical candidates that have well-understood biology and provide an opportunity to be first-to-market or offer a substantial benefit over existing therapeutic options.

About Commercial Our Commercial organization leads our global sales and marketing strategies around the world. Our integrated team continues to solidify BioMarin’s commercial presence in the United States and Europe and is rapidly growing in other regions, such as Latin America, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific.

BioMarin is the world leader in delivering therapeutics that provide meaningful advances to patients who live with serious and life-threatening rare genetic diseases. We target diseases that lack effective therapies and affect relatively small numbers of patients, many of whom are children.

These conditions are often inherited, difficult to diagnose, progressively debilitating, and have few, if any, treatment options.

BioMarin aims to improve life and health outcomes for people with rare diseases by advocating the use of innovative BioMarin therapeutics, advancing the standard of care and providing personalized support and services globally. BioMarin’s Commercial organization supports our global sales and marketing efforts around the world.

Our global sales force continues to solidify the company’s commercial presence in the United States and Europe and is rapidly growing in other regions, such as Latin America, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific. Come join our team and make a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

Build the playbook. Document what works. Turn your territory knowledge into a repeatable motion that scales.

3 months: Deep understanding of your verticals, consistent outbound motion running, shadowing your paired AE on deals.
6 months: Qualified pipeline generated, leading discovery calls, contributing meaningfully to deals.
9 months: Verticals producing consistent pipeline, leading full discovery independently, closing smaller deals.
12 months: Promotion-ready with proven ability to generate pipeline and close deals.

Relentlessly curious. You want to understand why buyers make decisions and what separates deals that close from deals that stall.

Determined to learn to close. You're here to become a great seller by working alongside people who've done it before.
Operate like a founder. You take ownership, make decisions without waiting for permission, and iterate quickly.
Technical enough. You don't need to code, but you need to understand how AI and computer vision solve real business problems.

s.h: ## CE QUE TU PEUX FAIRE BOUGER ##
s.t:
En tant que Consultant en automatisation UiPath (tous genres), tu feras partie de notre équipe Agentic Automation Platform et travailleras à la conception, au développement et à l-amélioration continue de solutions d-automatisation modernes. Tu combines une expertise technique avec une compréhension des processus et des exigences de nos clients.
* **Conception & développement :** Tu conçois, développes et implémentes des solutions d-automatisation modernes avec UiPath et les accompagnes tout au long de leur cycle de vie.
* **Analyse des processus :** Tu analyses les processus métier et identifies, avec les clients et les départements concernés, les potentiels d-automatisation appropriés.
* **Automatisation :** Tu mets en œuvre des workflows robustes et maintenables avec UiPath Studio et Orchestrator et soutiens leur exploitation et leur évolution.
* **Conseil client :** Tu travailles en étroite collaboration avec les analystes métier, les clients et les interlocuteurs techniques et traduis les exigences métier en solutions techniques.
* **Normes :** Tu soutiens l-introduction et le développement continu des standards et des meilleures pratiques d-automatisation.
* **Responsabilité de projet :** Selon ton expérience, tu assumes de plus en plus de responsabilités dans les projets et évolues vers un niveau senior.
* **Travail d-équipe :** Tu t-impliques activement dans notre équipe et dans les échanges professionnels autour de l-automatisation métier.

* **Formation :** Tu as une formation achevée ou un diplôme dans le domaine de l-informatique, du génie logiciel ou dans une discipline comparable.
* **Expérience professionnelle :** Tu disposes d-une première à plusieurs années d-expérience dans le développement de solutions d-automatisation avec UiPath.
* **Connaissances UiPath :** Tu évolues au moins au niveau Professional Developer et peux développer et mettre en œuvre des solutions UiPath de manière autonome.
* **Certification :** Une certification UiPath Automation Developer Professional ou une qualification comparable est un avantage.
* **Compréhension des processus :** Tu as une bonne compréhension des processus métier et peux expliquer clairement les solutions techniques aux départements métier et aux clients.
* **Méthode de travail :** Tu travailles de manière structurée, orientée solution et autonome et souhaites te développer professionnellement et personnellement.
* **Compétence en IA :** Tu utilises les outils d-IA dans ton domaine avec assurance, évalues les résultats de manière critique et aides les clients et adessi à exploiter les potentiels de l-IA.
* **Compétences linguistiques :** Tu communiques très bien en allemand et en anglais ; l-allemand est indispensable pour nos projets clients.
* **Contact client :** Tu apprécies le contact avec les clients et la collaboration dans des équipes interdisciplinaires.
* **Disponibilité pour les déplacements :** Tu es prêt à te déplacer pour des projets en Suisse.
Idéalement, tu apportes également
* **BPM :** Expérience avec BPMN ou la gestion des processus métier
* **Portefeuille UiPath :** Expérience avec d-autres composants du portefeuille UiPath, par ex. Orchestrator, Apps ou AI Center
* **IA :** Intérêt pour l-IA, les LLM et le développement de l-automatisation moderne
* **Conseil :** Première expérience en conseil technique ou en contact direct avec les clients
* **Développement :** Potentiel et motivation pour assumer à moyen terme des responsabilités en tant que Senior Consultant ou Technical Lead

Business Development Representative
Turn strong, growing inbound demand into qualified pipeline — supported by targeted ABX outbound and the industry’s biggest events
There are a lot of security companies out there, but no one is doing what Nucleus is doing: giving security teams the ability to run the most effective vulnerability and exposure management program possible. Some of the largest enterprises and government agencies in the world run on our platform, and we’re growing fast. Top-tier venture funding, an amazing team who will fight beside you to accomplish the impossible, great benefits, and fully remote.
Here’s the good news about this seat: our inbound demand is strong and growing. Your primary job is to work it well — respond fast, qualify sharply, and turn real interest into meetings your AE counterparts are glad to take. You’ll back that up with targeted outbound into named accounts as part of our account-based (ABX) program, and you’ll represent Nucleus face to face at the industry’s biggest security events a few times a year.
Why this role exists
This is a new seat created by growth — driven in large part by inbound volume we want to convert better and faster. Your individual output is visible and it matters. You’ll also be joining a leader whose real strength is developing top-performing BDRs: structured onboarding, weekly coaching and mock calls, and a documented track record of promoting reps into account executive, solutions engineering, customer success, and marketing roles.

Own inbound — this is the priority. Be the first, fast, credible response to the people raising their hands: demo requests, content and webinar leads, event follow-up, and trial interest. Qualify with real discovery — need, timing, environment, decision process — and convert genuine interest into meetings that stick. Speed and judgment both matter: our buyers are busy, and the first good conversation usually wins.
Support the ABX program with targeted outbound. Outbound here is deliberate, not a numbers game. You’ll work a defined set of high-value named accounts alongside Marketing and your AEs — using intent and account signals to time your outreach — so outbound reinforces the accounts we’ve collectively decided matter most.
Personalize everything, and use AI to do it well. Our buyers are technical and busy. You’ll write outreach and follow-up that sounds like a person who understands their world — and you’ll use AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) every day to research faster and sharpen your messaging.
Run a clean process. Manage inbound routing, accounts, and follow-up in Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Outreach, and Gong — and partner closely with your AEs and Marketing to act on campaign signals fast.
Represent Nucleus at our biggest events. A few times a year, our BDRs are the front line at RSAC, Black Hat, the Gartner Security & Risk Management Summit, and other key events — proactively engaging people in and around our booth, qualifying on the spot, and booking high-quality meetings. Expect roughly 3–4 events a year, plus our annual company and sales kickoff.
Your first 90 days
We’ve run this playbook before, and we don’t leave ramp to chance:
First 30 days
By 60 days
By 90 days
Structured onboarding and product training. Learn our market, ICP, and the vulnerability and exposure management problems our buyers face. Shadow calls, run mock calls, and start handling live inbound with close coaching.
Owning inbound response and qualification for your patch, with outbound sequences live into your named ABX accounts. Weekly 1:1s and email-writing sessions to sharpen your craft.
Fully ramped and holding your own number — converting inbound into qualified meetings, supporting ABX outbound, and confident enough in the material to represent Nucleus in front of a security buyer.

2–4+ years in sales or business development — BDR/SDR, inside sales, or another customer-facing role. Experience handling real inbound volume with a high qualification bar is especially relevant.
Sharp qualification instincts. You can tell a genuine opportunity from a tire-kicker quickly, and you protect your AEs’ calendars without dropping real interest on the floor.
Outbound capability too. You can build and run a thoughtful, targeted sequence into a named account when it matters — not just work a queue.
Cybersecurity or technical SaaS experience preferred. Holding a credible conversation with a security buyer is a meaningful advantage.
Strong communication. Concise and credible in writing and on the phone with senior technical people.
Comfortable in person. You genuinely enjoy meeting people face to face and can open a conversation with a stranger on a busy expo floor.
AI-fluent. Using AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, and Claude in your daily workflow is a requirement, not a bonus.
Tech-savvy. Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Gong, Slack, Teams, and Zoom.
Curious, resilient, and coachable. You want to be coached — this is a team where you’ll get real feedback and be expected to use it.
Nice to have: selling into U.S. Federal, Defense, or State & Local government; an established cybersecurity network; a bachelor’s or associate degree.
If you have less experience than the range above but can show real results and genuine curiosity about security, we’d still like to hear from you. We hire for trajectory and coachability, not just years on a resume.
Why you should be excited
The mission. We automate enterprise vulnerability and exposure management so security teams can prioritize and mitigate risk, at scale — working toward a world where remediation outpaces exploitation.
Warm demand to work with. You’re not starting from zero. Inbound interest is real and growing, and your job is to make the most of it.
The career path. A launchpad, run by a leader who builds and promotes top performers into AE, solutions engineering, customer success, and marketing roles.
Nucleus believes “work is people”, and when our people succeed, our company succeeds.

Des personnes impliquées veulent faire bouger les choses et le font simplement. Nous concevons et développons des logiciels qui enthousiasment nos clients. Dans des projets qui nous challengent. Et cela dans un environnement qui nous plaît, où le succès se crée ensemble et où chacun se sent bien.

s.h: ## VOTRE RÔLE - CE QUI VOUS ATTEND ##
s.t:
* **Direction d'équipe :** Vous dirigez une équipe d'ingénierie de test, la développez continuellement et favorisez la collaboration. Vous coordonnez les missions de projet de vos membres d'équipe.
* **Gestion du personnel :** Vous vous occupez du recrutement, du développement et de la fidélisation des collaborateurs.
* **Développement :** Vous faites avancer les stratégies de test internes d'adesso sur des sujets actuels tels que l'automatisation des tests, les tests assistés par IA ou les technologies cloud.
* **Veille du marché et analyse des tendances :** Vous observez le marché et les tendances actuelles et développez des idées pour des innovations produits.
* **Relations clients :** Vous développez continuellement votre réseau client, êtes l'interlocuteur direct de nos clients et êtes opérationnellement impliqué dans les projets. Vous conseillez les clients de manière stratégique et méthodologique sur toutes les questions liées aux tests.
* **Travail de projet :** Selon votre profil, vous apportez votre expertise en tant que test manager, automatisateur de tests, analyste métier (BA), product owner (PO) ou ingénieur des exigences (RE) et assumez des rôles de leadership dans les projets chez le client.
* **Conseil stratégique et méthodologique :** L'optimisation des processus métier ainsi que la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions informatiques sont au cœur de votre activité.

s.h: ## VOS COMPÉTENCES - CE QUE VOUS APPORTER ##
s.t:
**Consultant IT senior / manager avec affinité pour les tests**
* **Diplôme achevé** en informatique (économique) ou formation IT comparable ou expérience professionnelle IT
* **Expérience significative** en tant qu'analyste métier, product owner ou ingénieur des exigences dans des projets IT
* **Intérêt marqué et affinité** pour les tests et l'assurance qualité - des connaissances en automatisation des tests sont un plus mais pas obligatoires
* **Disponibilité et flexibilité** pour être déployé chez le client selon les besoins en tant que BA, PO ou RE
**Ce que vous apportez indépendamment du profil**
* **Expérience :** Bonnes capacités conceptuelles et analytiques ainsi qu'une forte communication et une compréhension rapide. Votre attitude est convaincante et assurée.
* **Qualités de leadership :** Vous avez une première expérience de gestion ou souhaitez évoluer vers un rôle de leader et construire et développer une équipe.
* **Communication :** Vous appréciez l'échange constant avec toutes les parties prenantes, êtes socialement compétent et communiquez de manière assurée et adaptée au public.
* **Compétences linguistiques :** Vous parlez très bien l'allemand (C1) et couramment l'anglais (B2) et êtes prêt à voyager.

s.h: ## DONNEUR D'OPPORTUNITÉS - CE QUI FAIT ADESSO ##
s.t:
Notre promesse : vous vous sentirez bien chez nous ! Collégial, communautaire et sur un pied d'égalité - nous vivons l'échange, l'esprit d'équipe et un respect mutuel. La diversité et les différents points de vue sont aussi appréciés chez nous que vous en tant que personne. Cela et bien plus encore représentent notre sentiment d'appartenance très particulier. Pour lequel il existe même un mot : adessi.
* **Apprenez et grandissez avec nous :** Avec plus de 400 offres de formation et notre plateforme d'apprentissage numérique, nous soutenons votre développement continu.
* **Vivez un véritable esprit d'équipe :** Des événements communs (par exemple, week-end ski et le voyage annuel de formation eduCamp), des journées d'accueil, des courses d'entreprise renforcent notre cohésion et vous permettent de faire partie de l'équipe dès le début.
Un engagement récompensé : votre investissement porte ses fruits - avec des primes pour les recommandations, les conférences, l'encadrement des travaux de fin d'études ainsi que des réductions attractives via notre portail Corporate Benefits.

Notre culture et notre collaboration sont marquées par la reconnaissance, l'appréciation et le soutien mutuels. Cela nous unit - même en télétravail. Le travail à temps partiel est possible sur accord (80-100%). Nous avons été à plusieurs reprises élus parmi les meilleurs employeurs de Suisse !

Notre large offre de formation et un modèle transparent de progression de carrière pour tous garantissent que votre développement ne stagne pas chez nous. Car grandir ensemble et être donneur d'opportunités, c'est inscrit dans notre ADN.

AI broke the network security model.
Agents, models, and APIs now need to reach data and systems scattered across clouds, data centers, edge sites, and customer environments. Every one of those connections is a new attack surface. VPNs, open inbound ports, and firewall rules were never designed for a world where the thing requesting access is a non-human identity that spun up four seconds ago.
NetFoundry replaces that model. Our Identity-First Connectivity™ platform delivers Zero Trust connectivity with no VPNs, no open inbound ports, and no firewall changes enabling enterprises to connect AI agents, APIs, and distributed workloads without exposing anything to the internet.
Enterprises use us to secure access to their APIs and agentic AI services, to run microsegmentation, and to simplify hybrid IT/OT segmentation. Software and IoT providers use us to reach workloads inside their customers' networks.
We were founded by the inventors and maintainers of OpenZiti, the world's most-used open source Zero Trust networking software. We're Series A, backed by SYN Ventures and Cisco Investments, headquartered in Charlotte, NC, and remote-first since day one.

About This Job
As a Business Development Representative on our outbound team, you'll find and open doors with dispensaries that haven't discovered Dutchie yet. You'll build target lists, run sequences, and start conversations that turn into qualified meetings for our Account Executives and Account Managers.

To succeed here, you'll need to be curious about the businesses you're prospecting into, resourceful when a first attempt doesn't land, and genuinely energized by the grind of top-of-funnel outbound — the volume, the research, the follow-up.
This role sits on a strong, growing sales team and comes with real coaching and mentorship as you ramp. You'll need to move comfortably across systems and adapt quickly as our outbound motion takes shape — prioritizing the accounts and activities that create the most pipeline. Your success will be rooted in consistent activity, sharp messaging, and a coachable mindset that keeps improving week over week.

Outbound Prospecting: Build and work target account lists across U.S. dispensaries, using state, license status, and market maturity to prioritize who you reach out to and when.
Multi-Channel Outreach: Run cold and warm outreach across call, email, and social, using the Dutchie Revenue Playbook to deliver consistent, proof-point-driven messaging that resonates with dispensary owners and operators.
Meeting Generation: Book qualified meetings for Account Executives and Account Managers, and manage a clean handoff so context and momentum aren't lost.
Pipeline Hygiene: Log activity, disposition, and source data accurately in HubSpot and Salesforce (Legacy and Greenpath), giving leadership reliable visibility into pipeline health.
Performance & Coaching: Hit weekly and monthly activity and meetings-booked targets, and show up for regular 1:1 coaching and Gong call reviews to keep sharpening your messaging and objection handling.
Market Intelligence: Share what you're hearing in the field — competitive signals, regional trends, buying triggers — so the team can keep refining how we target and message.

1+ years of experience in a sales, BDR/SDR, or outbound prospecting role, preferably within B2B SaaS or tech.
A track record of hitting activity and pipeline-generation targets in a metrics-driven environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to cold call and the ability to write outreach that doesn't sound templated.

Organizational skills to manage a high volume of accounts and outreach without losing attention to detail.
